name: Business-logic flaw in refund flow allows negative balance

input.title: Refund endpoint allows partial refund greater than the original charge
input.summary: POST /payments/:id/refund accepts { amount } without validating amount <= original charge. Submitting { amount: 999999 } returns more than the customer paid.

attacker.existing_authority: issue refund equal to charge amount

input.root_cause: Refund amount validation only checks amount > 0, not amount <= original_charge

rationale: Authn + authz + sanitization all intact; the bug is in business-logic validation. Reproduced in staging: merchant pulled $999,999 on a $20 charge.
